purpose: Estimate the causal contribution of Symthaea frontend memory, interface contracts and browser-grounded repair under a matched task, model, tool and environment protocol.

exposure_partitions.public_pilot: Used for development and debugging; excluded from hidden-holdout headline results.
exposure_partitions.controller_only: Agent sees task brief and rendered references, but fixture implementation and expected oracle details remain evaluator-controlled.
exposure_partitions.hidden_holdout: Private task and fixture content; fresh task release after a frozen evaluation window; no access by agents or retrieval systems.

comparison_arms.name: matched base agent
comparison_arms.description: Same foundation model, system prompt, browser access and engineering tools; no SFEB patterns, contract compiler or evidence-guided repair.

comparison_arms.name: documentation retrieval
comparison_arms.description: A0 plus conventional keyword/BM25/TF-IDF and pinned documentation retrieval.

comparison_arms.name: interface contract
comparison_arms.description: A1 plus the versioned Interface Contract Compiler and requirement-to-oracle traceability.

comparison_arms.name: browser evidence and repair
comparison_arms.description: A2 plus bounded browser capture, semantic source anchors, controlled interventions and regression replay.

comparison_arms.name: full Symthaea
comparison_arms.description: A3 plus the full qualified Symthaea engineering memory and selected cognitive retrieval backends.

comparison_arms.name: human engineer reference
comparison_arms.description: Experienced frontend engineer using the same brief, fixture, browser and acceptance contract; used as a reference distribution, not a model arm.

pairing.rule: Every agent arm receives the same task revision, source baseline, fixture digest, environment manifest, model version and tool budget for a paired block.
pairing.order: Randomize arm order within each task block using a frozen seed; publish the seed after the hidden evaluation window.
pairing.repeats: At least three independent trials per task and five for tasks classified high-variance before evaluation.
pairing.independence: Trials are repeated measurements nested within tasks. Do not treat task-trial rows as independent tasks when estimating uncertainty.
pairing.control: A0 must be rerun if model, prompt, tools, fixture, evaluator, browser or environment changes.

judging.primary: Independent contract oracle plus observed required journey outcomes; no agent self-report counts as acceptance evidence.
judging.visual: Region-aware geometric and perceptual measurements plus blinded human review; VLM scores are secondary evidence, not sole acceptance.
judging.accessibility: Automated semantic checks, keyboard journey replay and human assistive-technology review for a stratified subset.
judging.security: Negative role tests, fixture network egress policy and evidence of fail-closed handling.
judging.blinding: Judges do not see arm identity, model identity, run cost or agent self-evaluation before scoring.
judging.disagreement: Two independent judges for subjective outcomes; disagreement goes to a third adjudicator. Report raw agreement and Cohen's kappa; target kappa ≥0.80 before using a judge as the only source for subjective dimensions.
judging.human_review: Review 100% of disputed outcomes and a stratified random 20% of accepted and rejected cases.

metrics.cost_definition: Report provider/model cost, tool/runtime cost, retries, wall-clock time and human review cost. Primary efficiency denominator is accepted tasks, not attempted tasks.

analysis.binary_paired_outcome: Use exact McNemar test on per-task paired success/failure outcomes; report discordant-pair counts and paired absolute risk difference.
analysis.proportions: Report Wilson 95% intervals for each arm's accepted-task proportion.
analysis.continuous_metrics: Use paired task-cluster bootstrap intervals; sample tasks as clusters and retain all repeated trials within a sampled task.
analysis.multiple_comparisons: Pre-register A4 vs A0 as the primary contrast. Use Holm correction for secondary arm comparisons.
analysis.repeated_trials: Aggregate repeats within task before task-level paired tests, and additionally report per-trial distributions and within-task variability.
analysis.calibration: Report ECE with fixed bins plus Brier score; freeze calibration on a separate development split.
analysis.minimum_effect: Pre-register the minimum practically meaningful effect after a blinded pilot and before opening the holdout.
analysis.power: Perform power analysis from pilot discordant-pair rates and task-level variance. Do not infer sufficient power from raw task count alone.
analysis.stop_rule: No optional stopping on the hidden set. Stop only at the pre-registered task and trial counts or documented safety/validity failure.

success_criteria.benchmark_qualification: The separate mutation/oracle qualification must pass before any agent score is called qualified.
success_criteria.superiority: For the primary A4 vs A0 success difference, require a positive paired 95% confidence interval excluding zero and all hard gates passing.
success_criteria.noninferiority_efficiency: Alternatively, require success within a pre-registered 2 percentage-point non-inferiority margin and at least 30% lower cost per accepted task.
success_criteria.no_cross_benchmark_blending: Never pool SFEB, Vision2Web, Design2Code or browser-agent scores; reproduce each external benchmark's own protocol and report separately.

external_comparators.name: Vision2Web
external_comparators.scope: static UI, interactive multi-page frontend, long-horizon full-stack website development

external_comparators.name: Design2Code
external_comparators.scope: screenshot-to-code visual reconstruction over 484 real-world webpages

external_comparators.name: WebdriverIO Browser Agent Benchmark
external_comparators.scope: browser-tool comparison under a fixed model, harness and prompt; report current live run status at evaluation time

external_comparators.name: Coding benchmark quality audit
external_comparators.scope: task-quality auditing for underspecification, overstrict tests, low-coverage oracles and misleading prompts

limits: This file defines an evaluation protocol; it contains no model performance results.
The current SFEB task inventory is public-pilot material and is not sufficient for a contamination-resistant superiority claim.
Human-engineer references are distributions over qualified participants, not a single perfect gold implementation.
A score on an external benchmark is reportable only after a compatible, authorized reproduction of that benchmark's protocol.
